bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; DEST="$ROOT/.worktrees/sticker-current"; test -d "$DEST" || { echo WORKTREE_NOT_CREATED; exit 41; }; test -f "$DEST/.git" || { echo WORKTREE_NOT_LINKED; exit 42; }; test "$(git -C "$DEST" rev-parse HEAD)" = 4744dd1d4b092ca41f4104c427a65b154d9e83e6 || { echo WORKTREE_WRONG_SHA; exit 43; }; test -z "$(git -C "$DEST" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" || { echo WORKTREE_DIRTY; exit 44; }; printf 'WORKTREE_CORRECT=YES\n'; if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo NODE_HOST=YES; else echo NODE_HOST=NO; fi; if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo DOCKER_BIN=YES; else echo DOCKER_BIN=NO; fi; if test -f "$DEST/package.json"; then echo PACKAGE=YES; fi
